description: A former assistant district attorney and chairman of his county Republican Party, Chuck Efstration made a career of putting dangerous criminals behind bars and helping elect conservatives. Chuck was elected to the State House in 2013 and was elected Majority Leader by his Republican colleagues in November of 2022.
